description:
Haeru, who has the mysterious ability to predict the future, rejects fate and runs away. One day, the wrong scholar appeared in front of her! A monstrous man who blackmails the best street in the world and insists that the fight is made by the head, not the body. However, the moment she meets him, Hae-ru's stopped fate begins to change again. In the 15th century Joseon, the greatest genius Monarch of Joseon and a mysterious woman bound by the chains of fate, which cannot be recorded in the Annals, are sweet love and war!
